source.scope: project-level user-defined emitted-LB-log metrics; inherit backend_service_name and other resource labels

storm_predicate.job_shape: canonical lowercase UUID; noncanonical/unknown paths remain nonstorm
storm_predicate.reason: known429 status-poll cohort only; do not infer403 or identify individual callers

historical_reference.reason: previous metric/source/sampling receipt does not establish identical LB-log population

routing_candidates.hold: CloudRunbackend warning is not equivalent to all-LB4xx. Verify backend mapping, source semantics, sampled coverage and calibrate; keep current rule until reviewed replacement.

routing_candidates.existing_title: Cloud Armor denied requests per second is high
routing_candidates.hold: Reconcile existing deny filter with union of backend/edge DENY and statusDetails fallbacks; calibrate same-stream remainder.

storm_signal.deduplication: ArmorDENY429 is a subset of4xx; never add the two families
storm_signal.inhibit: none; eventual routing changes only exact storm instance, never nonstorm/security/escalation/5xx

required_acceptance: Verify all relevant LB backend sources and logConfig generation sample rates; preserve same configuration through calibration
Project-level user-defined metrics include sink-excluded entries; do not calibrate from retained sampled logs as if they were metric counts
Same fixed UTCwindow >=24h, exact filter fingerprints and observed partition identities per resource
Empty streams are unknown until source health proves expected ingestion; retain independent datasource/source canaries
Normal-floor and storm-ceiling evidence for each family in same emitted-count/minute units
Escalation must exceed positive calibrated floor and observed same-stream storm ceiling; remain globally uninhibited
Unrelated403/401/409 and unknownroutes/methods remain nonstorm; known429 is the only stormstatus
Independently verify Grafana notification and resolve receipts before any separate source/routing cutover
No new Monitoring policy plane; no active rule object, silent broad mute or automatic apply
